description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with explicit harness (AGENTS.md, init.sh, feature_list.json, claude-progress.md)

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: npm run build succeeds; launching `electron .` spawns main + renderer + GPU + network processes with no startup error (verified via `ps aux` and log inspection). BrowserWindow is created at 1200x800 with contextIsolation=true and nodeIntegration=false in src/main/main.ts.

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: DocumentList component (src/renderer/components/DocumentList.tsx) renders 'No documents yet...' when the list is empty, and document cards otherwise. Verified DocumentService.list() directly: returns [] on a fresh data directory, and returns the correct entry after a .md file is added to <userData>/knowledge-base-data/documents.

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: QuestionPanel (src/renderer/components/QuestionPanel.tsx) renders a text input and Ask button, calls window.knowledgeBase.qa.ask on Enter or click. Verified QaService.ask() directly: given a sample document and a question, returns the top matching paragraphs sorted by keyword-overlap score.

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: PersistenceService constructor calls ensureDirectories(). Verified on disk after launching the app: <userData>/knowledge-base-data/documents and <userData>/knowledge-base-data/index were both created.
